study: 十板块价量评分、实验上涨概率与动态资金配置
scope: Price-volume research only. No earnings, valuation, news, broker order flow or production account integration.
horizon_choice: 20 trading sessions, the previously proposed default; user explicitly selected backtestable price-volume scope.

feature_rules.availability: All ten funds have at least 120 actual historical observations and all required market-index observations. No fabricated prelisting data.
feature_rules.economic_tr: Causal gross daily total-return wealth from raw closes and official-effective splits/cash distributions, with theoretical daily reinvestment for features only. Not the earlier indicator-continuity line.
feature_rules.trend120: economic_tr / arithmetic mean of last 120 values - 1; larger better
feature_rules.flow20: (sum turnover_amount on positive economic return days - sum turnover_amount on negative return days)/sum turnover_amount over 20 actual sessions; larger better; NOT a fund-inflow estimate
feature_rules.volatility60: sample standard deviation of latest 60 simple economic daily returns times sqrt(252); lower better
feature_rules.scoring: Same-day average ranks among all ten funds; (rank-1)/9*100, risk reversed. Four equal 25% components. Score is relative ranking, NOT a probability.
feature_rules.TRIX: Original 12/9 causal signal and historical state, unchanged. Score only changes allocation among TRIX-long funds.

probability.label: At day t close predict purchase at t+1 raw open, terminal t+20 close, gross positive holding return. Includes split-adjusted shares and eligible cash/receivable dividends; cash not reinvested; no trading fees in label.
probability.label_accounting: Lock dividend eligibility at actual record-day end; recognize only at ex-date. Never double count not-yet-ex dividends in terminal price; only matured end dates used for evaluation/training.
probability.model: Fixed ridge logistic regression on four raw features. Training-only standardization, standardized values clipped to +/-5. Mean log loss plus 0.01/2 * squared non-intercept weights; no penalty on intercept.
probability.schedule: Monthly frozen fits. Training sample labels must end on/before the previous month's last market date. Expand from first complete feature date. All sectors share date boundaries. No random row splits or parameter search.
probability.prediction_period: 2024-04-01 to 2026-09-30; last 20 forecast cohorts may be unresolved and excluded from outcome metrics.
evaluation: fixed reliability bins and sample sizes
separate all matured rows and TRIX-long matured subset
200 joint-date moving-block bootstrap replicates with 20-date blocks, seed 20261005
probability.latest: September 30 historical prediction uses September fit. Separate October observation fit may use only labels matured by September 30, with September 30 features. Neither is October 6 live market data.
probability.allocation_use: None in this first study; probability diagnostic must be independently validated before it may size positions. No claim of calibrated personal trading odds. Twenty-session fixed-hold label is not identical to strategy trades that may exit earlier on TRIX.

allocation.HOLD: Original ten independently funded buy-and-hold sleeves, initial 10000 each, no rebalance.
allocation.INDEPENDENT_TRIX: Original ten independently funded daily TRIX sleeves, initial 10000 each, no cross-fund lending.
allocation.SHARED20: One cash pool. Among N TRIX-long funds, each target min(1/N,0.20); N=0 all cash.
allocation.SCORE: One cash pool. Each TRIX-long fund raw target 0.20*score/100; if sum exceeds 1 scale all proportionally down. Others zero. Unallocated capital stays cash.
allocation.MATCH_EQUAL: Same rebalance dates and total target allocation as SCORE, split equally among its eligible TRIX-long funds. Actual exposures can differ with prices, costs and lots.
allocation.rebalance: At initialization; whenever eligible TRIX-long set changes from preceding decision date; or when decision date is Friday. Otherwise actual holdings drift. A dead cross triggers next-session exit and full reallocation of remaining eligible funds.
allocation.target_equity: Known account net asset value at decision-date close, including cash, marked holdings and recognized dividend receivables; if account not yet started use initial capital. Never use execution-date closing equity.
allocation.execution: Next actual trading day's raw open plus explicit adverse slippage; sell first, then buy using available cash. Same-opening-price sell/buy sequence is a theoretical daily-bar assumption, not order-book proof.
allocation.quantity: 100-share lots. Target shares floor(target value / adverse buy price / 100)*100; zero target fully exits. When buys exceed cash, allocate available cash proportionally to desired orders including fees, round each down to affordable lots; remaining small cash is not redistributed by code or future performance.
allocation.cap: 20% target cap at rebalance, not an intraday hard stop; actual weight may drift above 20%.
allocation.restrictions: No leverage, shorting, external capital or new market gate. No ranking by later returns.

corporate_actions: Preserve original registration/ex/pay/split accounting. Dividend payments on a trading day are usable after that day's transactions. End mark-to-market with receivables, no forced final liquidation.

experiments.delay_stress: Both information and execution shifted one additional market day. This does not replace a separate settlement-delay or intraday fill simulation.

evaluation_limits: Past sample already repeatedly viewed; chronological replay is retrospective research, not truly unseen future validation.
Twenty-day labels overlap and sectors correlate; do not call rows independent observations.
Current surviving ETF pool fixed retrospectively; historical fund-universe selection bias remains.
Existing corporate-action evidence and source-version limits remain.
Scores and model coefficients are research assumptions, not calibrated probabilities or fundamental quality assessments.
Do not compare new 2024-2026 annualized returns directly to older 2022-2026 results.
Target-exposure-matched control is matched at scheduled rebalance; realized exposure differs with paths.
